🎮 HOW TO PLAY

Choose virtual Stars or one collectible gift as your stake, launch, then cash out before the rocket crashes. Your virtual payout is stake value × multiplier (for example, 100 × 15x = 1,500 virtual Stars). A gift used as a stake is consumed when the round starts; if the rocket crashes, the stake is lost. Cashing out at 10x or above also unlocks a bonus collectible. These coins and gifts have no real-world value and cannot be bought, transferred or withdrawn.

Choose 1–15 Booms and a virtual Star stake, then start. Pick any of the 16 tiles. Safe picks increase your multiplier; hitting a Boom ends the round and uses the virtual stake.

🎮 HOW BOOM 16 WORKS

There are 16 hidden tiles. Choose how many contain Booms (1–15). Each safe pick raises the multiplier based on the remaining safe tiles. Cash out after a safe pick to receive virtual Stars × multiplier. If you reveal a Boom, the round ends and the virtual Star stake is lost. Stars have no cash value and cannot be bought, transferred, or withdrawn.

🎁 CASE STORE
